assessment: Reviewed the seven-way comparison against public product and pricing materials, including ZipTie's redirected ziptie.ai pages. The guide discloses that it is documentation-based rather than hands-on, separates one-time diagnosis from recurring tracking, and presents price references with a re-verification warning.
